data.explanation: This is your landlord's yearly settlement (Betriebskostenabrechnung) of the heating, water, waste and other building running costs for 2026. Your actual share came to €2,193.78, against which your monthly advance payments of €154.33 (total €1,851.96) were credited, leaving €341.82 that you owe. The letter asks you to transfer this amount within 30 days of receiving the statement — pay by the deadline shown in the app. Your monthly advance payment stays the same for now. If you think the calculation is wrong, you can check the attached itemised breakdown (Einzelaufstellung) and query it with the management company; no formal objection procedure is stated here.
